args.stdin: WITH product AS (SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path AS product_record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp_color ON pv.product_sku = pvp_color.product_sku AND pvp_color.property_key = 'color' JOIN product_variant_properties pvp_volume ON pv.product_sku = pvp_volume.product_sku AND pvp_volume.property_key = 'volume' WHERE pv.brand = 'Sika' AND pf.product_family_name = 'Sika Weatherproof Sikaflex 1JG-02A Sealant' AND pvp_color.property_value_text = 'Gray' AND pvp_volume.property_value_text = '100 ml' LIMIT 1), stores_vienna AS (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city = 'Vienna'), inventory_sum AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM stores_vienna sv LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON sv.store_id = si.store_id AND si.product_sku = (SELECT product_sku FROM product)) SELECT (SELECT product_sku FROM product) AS product_sku, (SELECT product_record_path FROM product) AS product_record_path, (SELECT total_quantity FROM inventory_sum) AS total_quantity;
SELECT record_path FROM stores WHERE city = 'Vienna';
